title: CODESYS Development System Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of CODESYS Development System. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of python scripts. The issue results from the lack of resource separation between control spheres. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the Administrator.
